product_overview: Sistema web de apoio à decisão para carcinicultura, voltado à centralização de dados produtivos, biológicos, ambientais e financeiros. A plataforma oferece APIs para autenticação, gestão de viveiros e ciclos, registros operacionais, indicadores calculados, simulações e auditoria.
core_goals: Centralizar dados do cultivo em uma base integrada por organização, viveiro e ciclo
Apoiar o manejo alimentar com recomendações explicáveis baseadas em biomassa, biometria e tabela alimentar
Acompanhar desempenho zootécnico com cálculos de densidade, biomassa, sobrevivência e FCA
Integrar produção e finanças com cálculo de custos, receita, lucro, margem, ROA e ROE
Garantir rastreabilidade, segurança, permissões e auditoria das operações
Permitir evolução tecnológica por meio de API REST desacoplada e processamento analítico

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Permite registrar usuários, autenticar acesso e recuperar o perfil do usuário autenticado.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid user data -> Receive 201 with created account details -> POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/v1/auth/me with bearer token -> Receive 200 with current user profile
POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> GET /api/v1/auth/me without token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error

features.name: Viveiros (Ponds) Management API
features.description: Gerencia cadastro, consulta e listagem de viveiros com filtros, paginação e KPIs associados.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/viveiros/ with valid pond data and bearer token -> Receive 201 with created pond -> GET /api/v1/viveiros/ with filters and bearer token -> Receive 200 with paginated list and KPIs -> GET /api/v1/viveiros/{viveiro_id} with bearer token -> Receive 200 with pond details

POST /api/v1/viveiros/ with missing required fields -> Receive 422 validation error -> GET /api/v1/viveiros/{viveiro_id} with nonexistent ID -> Receive 404 not found error -> GET /api/v1/viveiros/ without bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error

features.name: Ciclos Produtivos (Production Cycles) API
features.description: Controla o ciclo de produção do viveiro, incluindo abertura, pausa e retomada.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/ciclos/ with valid pond reference and cycle data -> Receive 201 with started cycle -> GET /api/v1/ciclos/ with bearer token -> Receive 200 with cycle list and status filters -> POST /api/v1/ciclos/{ciclo_id}/pausar with bearer token -> Receive 200 with paused cycle status -> POST /api/v1/ciclos/{ciclo_id}/retomar with bearer token -> Receive 200 with resumed cycle status

POST /api/v1/ciclos/ with invalid or closed pond reference -> Receive 422 or 400 error -> POST /api/v1/ciclos/{ciclo_id}/pausar for inactive cycle -> Receive 409 conflict or 400 error -> POST /api/v1/ciclos/{ciclo_id}/retomar for cycle not in paused state -> Receive 409 conflict or 400 error

features.name: Biometrias (Biometrics Sampling) API
features.description: Registra amostragens biométricas e disponibiliza histórico para acompanhamento do crescimento e cálculos zootécnicos.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/biometrias/ with valid cycle, sample size, mean weight and health indicators -> Receive 201 with saved biometric record -> GET /api/v1/biometrias/ with bearer token -> Receive 200 with biometric history for ponds and cycles
POST /api/v1/biometrias/ with invalid sample size or missing weight data -> Receive 422 validation error -> GET /api/v1/biometrias/ without bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error

features.name: Manejo Alimentar (Feeding Management) API
features.description: Registra distribuição de ração, observações de consumo nas bandejas e consulta o histórico de manejos.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/manejos/ with valid cycle, feed quantity and tray observation data -> Receive 201 with saved feeding record -> GET /api/v1/manejos/ with bearer token -> Receive 200 with feeding management history
POST /api/v1/manejos/ with invalid feed quantity or missing cycle reference -> Receive 422 validation error -> GET /api/v1/manejos/ without bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error

features.name: Custos Operacionais (Operational Costs & Financial) API
features.description: Permite lançar custos operacionais e consultar consolidações e indicadores financeiros.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/custos/ with valid cost category, amount and cycle reference -> Receive 201 with saved cost entry -> GET /api/v1/custos/ with bearer token -> Receive 200 with operational cost list and financial summaries
POST /api/v1/custos/ with negative amount or missing category -> Receive 422 validation error -> GET /api/v1/custos/ without bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error

features.name: Simulacao de Despesca (Harvest Simulation & Decision Support) API
features.description: Executa simulações bioeconômicas de despesca e armazena o histórico das análises.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/simulacao/ with valid cycle data and scenario inputs -> Receive 200 with Delta-V recommendation and harvest decision support -> GET /api/v1/simulacao/ with bearer token -> Receive 200 with historical simulation list
POST /api/v1/simulacao/ with insufficient scenario inputs -> Receive 422 validation error -> POST /api/v1/simulacao/ without bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error

features.name: Auditoria (Audit Trail) API
features.description: Disponibiliza consulta somente leitura ao log imutável de ações e alterações do sistema.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/auditoria/ with valid action, entity or date filters and bearer token -> Receive 200 with matching audit entries -> GET /api/v1/auditoria/ with broader filters -> Receive 200 with paginated immutable audit history
GET /api/v1/auditoria/ without bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> GET /api/v1/auditoria/ with invalid date range -> Receive 422 validation error
